validated_patterns.description: The user repeatedly delays beginning large academic assignments until deadlines approach.

evidence.quote: I left the research brief untouched until the week it was due.
evidence.reason: A prior episode records delayed initiation of a substantial academic task.

evidence.quote: I started the current studio report only three days before submission.
evidence.reason: The current episode shows the same delay recurring with another academic task.

current_episode.summary: The user recalled, "I left the research brief untouched until the week it was due." They also said, "I started the current studio report only three days before submission." They felt anxious and guilty, then used a 20-minute outline session to begin and said it made the task feel manageable.

mood_observations.evidence: I feel anxious because I left the report so late.

reflections.reflection: The user recognized that delaying the start increases deadline pressure and that a short outline session made beginning easier.

evidence.reason: The current episode confirms the same response to ambiguous requirements.
